evidence_boundary: Phase 7 proves bounded provider-agnostic reranking over at most 20 accepted HybridHit candidates plus deterministic extractive context compression: one bounded provider score sequence, fail-closed score validation, stable rerank ordering, immutable provenance, at most 8 excerpts, 1200 characters per excerpt, and 6000 total excerpt characters, with frozen-plan conformance and Python 3.11-3.14 execution across Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS. It does not prove a concrete reranker model/runtime, generative compression, quality superiority, freshness/authority scoring, contradiction handling, claim verification, persistent vector storage, REST, MCP, or production deployment.
